summary.text: Sara Cambensy is an independent candidate for Michigan State Senate District 38 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Democrat while in office, she represented Michigan House District 109 from November 2017 to January 2023.

paragraphs.text: Cambensy assumed office in the Michigan House of Representatives on November 16, 2017, and was re-elected in 2020.
She did not run for re-election in 2022 and was succeeded by Jenn Hill (D).
Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments as including the Natural Resources and Outdoor Recreation Committee and the House Agriculture Committee.
